from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class FeeInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures specific court fee details for matching by amount and payer."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Numeric value of the fee")
    currency: Optional[str] = Field(description="Currency unit, typically '元'")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Party responsible for paying the fee")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g. '二审案件受理费'")

class PartyInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures party names and roles to match against specific parties in judgment results."""
    name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the party, e.g. '魏春玲'")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g. '上诉人', '再审申请人'")

class CaseRefInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures case numbers which serve as unique fingerprints for matching."""
    number: Optional[str] = Field(description="Full case number string, e.g. '（2023）辽 1481 民初 3995 号'")
    court: Optional[str] = Field(description="Court name if explicitly mentioned")

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all key information from a single judgment document needed for matching."""
    document_id: Optional[str] = Field(description="Identifier for the document being parsed, e.g. '《判决文书 1》'")
    parties: list[PartyInfo] = Field(description="List of parties involved with their roles")
    outcome_summary: Optional[str] = Field(description="The core ruling or outcome text, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判'")
    fees: list[FeeInfo] = Field(description="Court fee details found in the document")
    case_refs: list[CaseRefInfo] = Field(description="Relevant case numbers cited in the document")
    procedure_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of procedure, e.g. 'Civil Second Instance', 'Administrative Retrial'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level parser output containing extractions for the processed documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction] = Field(description="List of extracted information from each document")
